description: SIGHTIT is your personal AI data analyst, embedded directly in Power BI. It replies in plain language, generates bar, line, pie, doughnut, polar area, radar, scatter, bubble charts or tables upon your request. Drag in your data, ask a question in plain language, and get an instant analysis and visualization. Who is it for? Sales and Marketing teams looking for quick insights into performance. Managers and Decision-Makers who want direct answers from their data. Analysts who need to accelerate their workflow. Key Features Natural Language Queries: Translate plain questions like "compare sales by region" directly into data insights and visualizations. Instant Visualization: Automatically generate the appropriate chart for your query. On-Demand Data Analysis: Instantly calculate trends, correlations, comparisons, and outliers without manual setup. Conversational Interface: Ask follow-up questions to drill down and explore your data further in a continuous conversation. Example Questions You Can Ask "Show me total sales by month as a line chart" "Compare revenue year over year" "What is the correlation between marketing spend and new users?" "Which 5 products have the highest profit margin?"
